scope: Source-only drafts for three captions. No acceptance, production edit, app build, CI, release or remote publication.
sources: Four full pinned LibreOffice Amharic PO snapshots. All selected lexical pairs checked for absence of fuzzy flag. AOSP was not needed because direct geometry pairs were recovered.
web_search: Supplementary web queries for LibreOffice Amharic shape terms did not produce stronger native/authoritative terminology evidence. Search results were not used as lexical evidence.
limits: No native-speaker validation. No claim that alternatives are authoritative; unattested alternatives are explicitly flagged. No claim of fresh retrieval of reused snapshots.
excluded: Held Crop, fill, calligraphy and Swap are outside scope.
